    field is the minimum wait before polling again — respect it. Never start a second

tools.description:
Get the full raw result of a COMPLETED job.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description:
List the cloud accounts this API key can scan, with their status.

    Only a connection with status CONNECTED or VERIFIED can be scanned. PENDING means
    the human hasn't created the CloudFormation stack yet.

tools.name: get_connection
tools.description: Get one cloud account connection: status, region, and last error if any.

tools.name: create_cloud_connection
tools.description:
Start linking a cloud account so it can be scanned. `provider` is "aws", the only
    provider supported today; `account_id` is the 12-digit AWS account number.

tools.name: verify_connection
tools.description:
Check whether the read-only role for a connection exists yet and mark it
    VERIFIED if so.

    Expect this to fail while the human's CloudFormation stack is still creating —
    that's normal, not a misconfiguration. Retry every ~15 seconds for up to ~5
    minutes before reporting a problem.

tools.description: List the Tomorrow Central tools this platform offers (id, name, what it does).

tools.name: whoami
tools.description:
Identify the account this API key belongs to, and its plan. Useful for
    confirming the key works before doing real work.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_cloud_connection, run_cost_scan · Private data: list_connections, create_cloud_connection, whoami, report_feedback, submit_rating, run_cost_scan, price_lookup, estimate_cost, describe_workload · Public sink: submit_rating, price_lookup, estimate_cost · Destructive: run_cost_scan, list_cost_findings, describe_workload, where_can_this_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_cloud_connection, run_cost_scan · Private data: list_connections, create_cloud_connection, whoami, report_feedback, submit_rating, run_cost_scan, price_lookup, estimate_cost, describe_workload · Public sink: submit_rating, price_lookup, estimate_cost · Destructive: run_cost_scan, list_cost_findings, describe_workload, where_can_this_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
